name: submit_training_job
description: Submit a SageMaker training job. Pre-creates an MLflow run in RUNNING state so the training container resumes it via MLFLOW_RUN_ID. Returns thread_id, job_id, sagemaker_job_name, mlflow_run_id, and mlflow_run_url.

thread_id.description: Thread ID for this conversation (= AgentCore session_id). PK of the DynamoDB thread row.

training_type.description: Training algorithm — LLM fine-tuning: grpo|sft|dpo; tabular: xgboost|sklearn (default: grpo)

max_samples.description: Max dataset samples to use; 0 means use entire dataset (default: 0)

train_split.description: HuggingFace split name for the training set (default: train). Override when the dataset uses non-canonical splits, e.g. HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k → train_sft. Resolve from the mandatory pre-flight EDA via huggingface-skill___retrieve_dataset_metadata.

test_split.description: HuggingFace split name for the eval/test set (default: test). Override when the dataset uses non-canonical splits, e.g. HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k → test_sft. Resolve from the mandatory pre-flight EDA via huggingface-skill___retrieve_dataset_metadata.

max_depth.description: XGBoost only — maximum tree depth (default: 6). Ignored by non-xgboost training_type values.

n_estimators.description: XGBoost only — number of boosting rounds / trees (default: 100). Ignored by non-xgboost training_type values.

target_column.description: Tabular training (xgboost/sklearn) only — name of the label column in the loaded DataFrame. Required when dataset_name is an s3:// URI or HuggingFace repo id; defaults to 'target' for bundled sklearn datasets (iris, breast_cancer, wine, digits). Ignored by LLM training_type values.

_user_id.description: Authenticated user id — always pass the value of the CURRENT_USER_ID env var. Stored on the DynamoDB thread row for attribution.

name: complete_training_job
description: Retrieve final status and model artifact S3 URI for a SageMaker training job.

name: deploy_model
description: Deploy a trained model artifact to a SageMaker real-time inference endpoint, OR (R5, target='bedrock') import it into Bedrock Custom Model Import. Bedrock import is async and resumes the agent thread via the bedrock-import poller (15-min schedule); the SageMaker path is sync.

sagemaker_job_name.description: Training job whose artifact to deploy

endpoint_name.description: Name for the new endpoint (sagemaker target only)

instance_type.description: Inference instance type (default: ml.m5.xlarge; sagemaker target only)

target.description: (R5) Deploy target. 'sagemaker' (default) creates a SageMaker real-time endpoint — returns endpoint_name + endpoint_url. 'bedrock' imports the model artifact into Bedrock Custom Model Import — returns bedrock_model_name + import_job_arn + job_id. Bedrock import is async; the bedrock-import poller (15-min schedule) resumes the agent thread on terminal status.

bedrock_model_name.description: (R5, bedrock target only) Name for the imported Bedrock model. Must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9-_.]+$ and be ≤ 63 chars. Default: the SageMaker training job name with non-alphanumerics replaced by '-'.

thread_id.description: (R5, bedrock target only) Always pass CURRENT_THREAD_ID so the poller can resume the right session when the Bedrock import reaches a terminal state. Ignored when target='sagemaker'.

_user_id.description: (R5, bedrock target only) Always pass CURRENT_USER_ID so the poller resume call carries the original user identity. Ignored when target='sagemaker'.

name: list_hub_models
description: List SageMaker Hub models available for fine-tuning. Returns name, version, EULA status, supported recipes, license, and ARN for each. Read-only — no cost, no confirmation required. Call this before `submit_training_job` when the user has not named a specific model, or when they ask `what models are available`. When a returned model has `requires_eula=true`, follow the EULA hard-rule in planning/SKILL.md before any submit.

hub_name.description: SageMaker Hub to enumerate (default: SageMakerPublicHub). Omit to use the public hub; pass a private hub name for tenant-scoped discovery.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring match on HubContentName (e.g. `Llama`, `Nova`, `Qwen`). Omit to return all models.

_user_id.description: Authenticated user id — always pass the value of the CURRENT_USER_ID env var.

name: submit_eval_job
description: Launch an async SageMaker Processing job that runs mlflow.genai.evaluate against a Bedrock or SageMaker-endpoint target with a Bedrock judge. Returns immediately with thread_id/job_id/mlflow_run_url; the thread row is updated via EventBridge when the Processing job finishes.

thread_id.description: Thread ID for this conversation (= AgentCore session_id). PK of the DynamoDB thread row. Always pass CURRENT_THREAD_ID.

eval_dataset_s3_uri.description: JSON eval-spec S3 URI produced by huggingface-skill___prepare_eval_dataset — the Processing container materialises the dataset inside

target_model.description: Model under evaluation. Format: bedrock:/<model_id> (prefer the us.* cross-region inference profile) or sagemaker:/<endpoint_name>

judge_model.description: Optional LLM-as-judge override. Format: bedrock:/<model_id>. Defaults to bedrock:/us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0.

scorers.description: Canonical MLflow scorer class names ONLY. The agent MUST call mlflow-skill___list_scorers first to retrieve the live catalog and reason about which canonical name matches each user-supplied term (e.g. 'faithfulness' → RetrievalGroundedness, 'answer relevance' → RelevanceToQuery) by reading the returned docstrings. Pass the resolved canonical names verbatim — the Processing container rejects plain-English aliases and raises ValueError listing valid names. Guidelines evaluates answer_groundedness by default.

task.description: Evaluation task type — drives default prompt extraction inside the container

run_name.description: Optional friendly name for the MLflow run

_user_id.description: Authenticated user id — always pass CURRENT_USER_ID env var

custom_scorer_lambda_arns.description: (R6) Optional list of AWS Lambda ARNs that implement the custom-scorer contract (see agent/.claude/skills/mlflow/SKILL.md §Custom Scorers). Each Lambda is invoked per evaluation row with a {inputs, outputs, expectations} payload and must return {name, score, reason?} where score is numeric. 5-second timeout per row. Non-200 responses, non-numeric scores, and invoke failures are logged and treated as null metrics — the evaluation still completes. Omit or pass [] for MLflow built-ins only.

name: submit_monitoring_job
description: Run an Evidently drift + data-quality (+ classification-quality when labels are available) report on a completed tabular training job. Handler resolves baseline + model artifact URIs from the DDB thread row keyed on sagemaker_job_name; agent does not pass S3 URIs. Returns immediately; EventBridge callback updates the thread row on Processing-job completion.

current_data_s3_uri.description: Optional. s3://bucket/key.csv or s3://bucket/prefix/. Mutually exclusive with use_training_eval_split.

use_training_eval_split.description: Default false. When true, handler reads jobs.<source>.eval_split_s3_uri from DDB.

target_column.description: Optional label column name. Enables ClassificationPreset when the column exists in the current CSV.

name: submit_recommendation_job
description: Run an async SageMaker AI Benchmark job that measures TTFT / inter-token latency / P99 / throughput of a trained LLM on a single specified GPU instance. Handler deploys a temporary endpoint + InferenceComponent using the training job's model artifact, benchmarks with the supplied (or default) workload spec, parses profile_export.jsonl, and tears down all created resources. Wall-clock 15–40 min per run; typical spend $2–6 for g5/g6 families. Non-LLM training types (xgboost/sklearn) rejected with a clear MCP error.

sagemaker_job_name.description: Completed training job with training_type in {sft, dpo, grpo}.

instance_type.description: Single GPU instance like ml.g6.xlarge. ml.m*/ml.c*/ml.t* rejected.

serving_image_uri.description: Override the auto-derived TGI inference image. Any SageMaker-compatible LLM serving image (TGI/vLLM/LMI/Triton/custom).

serving_env.description: Env vars for the serving container. When serving_image_uri is provided the caller owns this dict.

name: get_recommendation_results
description: Read the benchmark outcome from the thread row. Pure DDB lookup. Safe to call mid-run — returns the current status (SUBMITTING/DEPLOYING/BENCHMARKING) without metrics while the job is still progressing. Do NOT poll; wait for the EventBridge callback ('Recommendation job X is now Completed') before calling.

name: list_recent_training_jobs
description: List this project's recent SageMaker training jobs across ALL sessions, newest first. Use when the user references 'the most recent Completed <type> job' and the current session has no candidate — pick the newest entry with the matching training_type, then pass its sagemaker_job_name to submit_monitoring_job / submit_recommendation_job. Each entry: sagemaker_job_name, status, training_type (sft/dpo/grpo/xgboost/sklearn), dataset_name, thread_id, creation_time.
